evidence: 009 (swarm-14, no diff): resolve contradictions by setting invalid_at=new.valid_at, expired_at=now(); old facts never deleted; tenant-scoped candidate selection; detection (heuristic) kept separate from invalidation (deterministic). File: src/tenanos/memory/invalidation.ts.

089 (integrated): MemoryCandidate JSON schema. Proposal surface ONLY by design: no status field, no promotion logic. 089's own STATE notes call out 009 as 'distinct artifacts (invalidation logic vs proposal schema), no file overlap'. 009 operates post-promotion on knowledge nodes; 089 operates pre-promotion on candidate proposals. Different lifecycle stages.

098 (integrated): context-pack.ts, pure RETRIEVAL->CONTEXT PACK->WORKER assembler. Read-side only: no writes, no lifecycle mutation, no invalidation. 098's STATE notes: 'No overlap with ... swarm-14 P-20260923-009 (memory/invalidation.ts, different file and layer)'.

099 (proposed, spec at swarm-05/TRANSITION-LOG-SPEC.md): KNOWLEDGE_TRANSITIONED events making lifecycle corrections replayable. Its STATE notes explicitly coordinate: '009 owns store-side bitemporal representation, this spec owns the event/replay level; 009 consumes the supersedes_node_id link'. Complementarity is asserted by the spec author, not inferred.

009 fills the write-side invalidation gap: no integrated or proposed item performs bitemporal supersession. 089 proposes, 009 invalidates, 098 reads, 099 replays. Four distinct layers, no shared files.

File scope: src/tenanos/memory/invalidation.ts is unclaimed by any other proposal (verified against STATE.json); src/tenanos/memory/ currently holds only MemoryCandidate.schema.json and context-pack.ts. No file overlap.
notes: Implementation at impl/P-20260923-009/: invalidation.ts (strict TS) + jest test proving (1) contradiction resolution sets old.invalid_at = new.valid_at and old.expired_at = now, (2) the old record is never deleted (store only grows), (3) cross-tenant invalidation is rejected fail-closed, (4) unconfirmed (heuristic-only) detections cannot invalidate, (5) bitemporal asOf reads show the old fact before supersession and the new fact after. Detection is a pluggable Detector interface; invalidation is deterministic and requires confirmed=true.

overlaps.resolution: Proposal schema (pre-promotion) vs invalidation logic (post-promotion). Different lifecycle stages, different files.
Read-side pack assembly vs write-side invalidation. Different layers.
